name: BundlePress
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
BundlePress is a lightweight and powerful solution for group bundle making in WooCommerce.

Improve your store’s user experience by clearly listing what products are included in a group bundle package.

Features:
* Group bundle making: Add multiple product IDs to any product to create a bundle list.
* Automatically displays the list of group-bundled products on the single product page.
* Enable or disable bundle functionality globally.
* Modern and clean settings interface.
* Lightweight and performance-optimized.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bundlepress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘BundlePress’ menu to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

The final version will integrate deeply with WooCommerce, though this initial version provides basic framework support.

How do I use the shortcode?

Simply add [bundlepress_info] to any post or page.
